verdict.rationale: Mollie offers hosted checkout, e-commerce plugins (Shopify/WooCommerce/Magento), Payment Links, and Mollie Components, all of which support fast onboarding and card acceptance without deep integration work. Docs emphasize simple module installs and no-code payment links, consistent with going live within a day. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual sign-up-to-first-payment timing, and explicit confirmation of instant merchant verification/KYC turnaround.
